title: Photostable wide-bandgap perovskites with enhanced interface coupling for all-perovskite tandems
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,958-968
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06683B, Paper
Chunyan Li, Yao Zhang, Haiyan Zhao, Jixiang Zhang, Zhongxun Yu, Xiaoan Tang, Yudong Wang, Han Chen
A molecular bridging strategy is employed to reinforce the chemical and electronic coupling across the hole-collecting SAM/perovskite interface, enabling photostable 1.76 eV perovskites and all-perovskite tandem solar cells with 29.58% efficiency.
